{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool overcoat, relaxed fit, knee-length hem, charcoal gray with hex code #36454F, thick melton fabric.
Tailored trousers, straight cut, ankle length, forest green with hex code #228B22, heavy twill fabric.
Wool knit blouse, slightly boxy silhouette, hip length, cream with hex code #FFFDD0, ribbed cotton blend fabric.
Leather ankle boots, round toe, mid-calf height, dark brown with hex code #654321, smooth full-grain leather fabric.

This outfit is perfect for a brisk autumn walk in the park because the heavy wool overcoat and twill trousers provide necessary warmth against the deep frost without sacrificing mobility. The relaxed fit of the blouse and straight-cut trousers allow for comfortable walking while maintaining a polished, neat appearance suitable for hanging out with friends. The earthy color palette of charcoal, forest green, and cream complements the natural autumn setting, creating a cohesive and cozy look that respects your need for one layer of openness."}
